train_video_classification_model: train a SlowFast video classification model using a config file and launch_job with the train function
test_video_classification_model: test a trained SlowFast video classification model with multi-clip ensemble views from a config file
run_demo_inference: run a SlowFast demo inference on video input using the demo function with a loaded config
visualize_model_predictions: visualize SlowFast model predictions and wrong predictions via TensorBoard using the visualize function
load_and_infer_config: load a SlowFast config file and infer missing defaults using load_config and assert_and_infer_cfg
